title: Ping^2
description: A mod that simulates very high ping... or at least tries
body:
# Ping^2
### A mod that simulates incredibly high ping. 
(and it works with multiplayer)

__________

## Features:

Refunding: No. Not as in refunding the game. It refunds blocks by removing ones you just placed and giving it back to you.

Re-mine: You mine a block? How about not!

Rubberbanding: You (or mobs) will teleport to a spot you were at before at random... not like from a while ago, but a recent spot. (fun in the Nether)

Freezing: Freezes you in place like the server disconnected.

__________

## How it is made

The mod was made completely from scratch. It may not be 100% accurate, but still super "fun". 
Bedrock simulator.
